newsitem.title: USA: Emcee gets $2.5 mln in lawsuit settlement.
newsitem.headline: Emcee gets $2.5 mln in lawsuit settlement.

text.p: Emcee Broadcast Products Inc said Friday it has received a $2.5 million payment to settle ligitation in connection with the sale of a cellular telephone license.

Emcee said it was granted the license by the Federal Communications Commission for a $3.1 million fee. It said it later sold the license to a Pennsylvania partnership, which it identified in federal regulatory filings as Americell PA-3 LP, in 1991.
The buyer paid an initial $1.0 million and issued a $2.1 million note for the remainder, but had not paid by due date on December 16, 1996, it said. Emcee sued to recover the amount.

Emcee said that in addition to the $2.5 million payment, the settlement agreement also calls for the payment of $500,000 when, among the other things, the partnership sells its cellular telephone system.
Emcee makes and markets analog and digital transmitters and related hardware for the wireless cable industry.
